profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: This inspiration for knowledge, work-ethic, and experience in customer-oriented positions provides me the ability to be a phenomenal team player who can lead by example.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
General website maintenance and optimization across all four company restaurants.
Provide remote IT assistance across all facets of the company and its concepts.
Establish and update all social media accounts
Configure and update DNS for each site to forward old domain to new domain.
Responsible for the design and development of www.wjprestaurantconsulting.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Assisted in rebranding and updating the signup process to use the Vue Framework
Helped maintain and debug issues on the existing code on the Django Framework
Pivotal force in creating a brand new product and revenue in the form of Gifting
Tasked with implementing new designs and features for Onboarding on a biweekly basis
Responsible for Front End Development on all of the company's applications, both company and customer facing

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Dev Bootcamp is the first short-term, immersive bootcamp that transforms beginners into full-stack web developers in 19 weeks. 
The program puts great emphasis on developing self-reliance and resilience and values experiential learning over traditional classroom lectures. 
Graduates of the program will have robust experience in Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Sinatra, HTML5 & CSS, JavaScript, Test Driven Development, Agile Development, Git and Source Control, Pair Programming, Advanced Web Technologies, as well as softer skills to make graduates competitive applicants as Web Developers.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Installed and configured network connected devices including but not limited to: computers, printers, receipt printers, and VOIP phones
Diagnosed and repaired every technical related issue involving: the network (faulty ethernet cables), computer hardware (i.e broken displays, broken mouse) and software (i.e. POS system, knowledge on how to use a specific program, memory leaks), printers (incorrect colors, broken gears)
Maintained and updated existing site with new content and optimized their website by compressing all images and files to decrease load time.
Enhanced the design of the website to responsively adapt to different screen sizes

projects.title: Easy Noms
projects.description: A native mobile application used to expedite the process of selecting where to eat, operating like Tinder for restaurants. Easy Noms uses your geo-location to find restaurants in your area and provides pictures to browse through using swipe functionality. The front-end was constructed using React Native, and the back-end with Ruby on Rails 4.

projects.title: Gomer
projects.description: Gomer is a Pomodoro Technique influenced time tracker. This was inspired by my time at Dev Bootcamp. Many in the cohort would use this technique to stay motivated and make sure we were concentrating on the project at hand. The only thing I believed we were missing was somewhere to take notes, or add a to do for later, or just a reminder. That is what I set out to accomplish with Gomer.
